Ella: Quick scrub on hosted/dedicated/private fidelity. Need to decide what "parity" promises we give vs cost/complexity tradeoffs.
Tim: IMO parity = API surface and observable semantics. Not runtime perf guarantees.
Ajay: +1. Also propose a minimal adapter surface: auth, routing hints, kv-cache controls, model-variant fallback hints.
Marcus: Question — do we force auth translation at adapter, or allow passthrough? That shapes Private/VPC flows.
Ella: Prefer adapter-translate for hosted/dedicated, private can opt out. Suggest config flag `auth.mode: passthrough|translate`.
Ops: If adapters translate, rollout needs a backward compat plan — can't break in-flight tokens.
Tim: Also need a clear trace propagation rule. We should allow X-Trace-Id passthrough and adapter-to-span mapping.
Ajay: Proposed header whitelist: X-Trace-Id, X-Request-Mode, X-Cache-Key. Adapter maps to internal labels for routing/metrics.
Ella: Quick config sketch:
`````
auth:
  mode: translate
adapter:
  expose_headers: [X-Trace-Id, X-Request-Mode, X-Cache-Key]
`````
Tim: Add a fallback policy too: `model_variant_fallback: prefer-compat | degrade-latency` to make behavior explicit.
sre-bot: deploy queued: canary to eng-runtime tomorrow 09:00 UTC :rocket:
Ella: I'll open a short RFC follow-up with these points and tag @eng-runtime @security. Keeping scope minimal for canary. :thumbsup:
